hint_line: Frequency prior (estimate-derived, SamasaChakram ADR 0004): tatpuruṣa is the most common class, then bahuvrīhi, dvandva and avyayībhāva are rare; within tatpuruṣa prefer ṣaṣṭhī, then nañ, upapada, tṛtīyā, saptamī, prādi; the largest tatpuruṣa subtype group is karmadhāraya led by viśeṣaṇa-pūrvapada.
